name: How much does it cost to clear a clogged kitchen sink?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to clear a clogged kitchen sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to clear a clogged kitchen sink can vary based on the severity and location of the clog. Simple clogs often requiring plunging or minor snaking can be less expensive. More complex blockages deeper in the main drain line or those requiring specialized equipment, like hydro-jetting, will typically incur higher costs. Factors like the plumber's hourly rate and emergency service fees can also influence the total price. We provide upfront pricing after assessing the specific issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on clog severity and location. Simple clogs are less expensive than complex ones requiring specialized tools.
